prompts.prompt:
A router reports fast=4 and green=4 for routes (id 8, delay 2, watts 7) and (id 4, delay 6, watts 3), in that order. The fast profile must select route 8, and the green profile route 4. Fast minimizes delay, then watts. Green minimizes watts, then delay. If both values tie, the earlier input wins. Empty batches return zero IDs. All measurements are small nonnegative integers.

Find and repair the regression. You may inspect any current project source and run ./verify. Stay in the current project, preserve the public interface, and change only production code. Return JSON edits with a relative filename, a nonempty exact substring unique in that file, and its replacement. The runner applies all edits and runs ./verify. The verifier and source collection already ran. Use the prepared context directly if sufficient.

--- eco.tide ---
eco routes:*{Route} > i
let chosen fold routes (initial routes) best row next
  if (or (< (get watts next) (get watts best)) (< (get delay next) (get delay best))) next best
get id chosen


--- interactive.tide ---
interactive routes:*{Route} > i
let chosen fold routes (initial routes) best row next
  if (or (< (get delay next) (get delay best)) (< (get watts next) (get watts best))) next best
get id chosen


--- routes.tide ---
record Route
id:i delay:i watts:i

initial routes:*{Route} > {Route}
case (at routes 0) (make Route id 0 delay 0 watts 0) head head


--- summary.tide ---
record Choice
fast:i green:i

choose routes:*{Route} > {Choice}
make Choice fast (interactive routes) green (eco routes)

main batches:**{Route} > *{Choice}
fold batches (list {Choice} 0) acc row batch append acc (choose batch)

A print order has two independent jobs. Job A contains colour page runs [1] and mono runs [1,1]. Job B contains colour runs [1] and mono runs [2,1]. The stock report gives 1 colour sheet and 4 mono sheets; the customer expects 2 of each. Within one job, runs of the same kind may share sheets. A colour sheet holds four pages; a mono sheet holds three. Sheets cannot be shared between jobs or kinds. Empty runs and jobs use no sheets. Counts are nonnegative small integers.

Find and repair the regression. You may inspect any current project source and run ./verify. Stay in the current project, preserve the public interface, and change only production code. Return JSON edits with a relative filename, a nonempty exact substring unique in that file, and its replacement. The runner applies all edits and runs ./verify. The verifier and source collection already ran. Use the prepared context directly if sufficient.
